'''Luna''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was one of the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|freedom fighters]] that were led by [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], they were among the Twi'leks that were massacred by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] forces during the initial stages of the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]]. After their [[Death/Legends|death]], Luna was one of the many freedom fighters that were buried in a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] graveyard on [[Ryloth/Legends|their homeworld]].

The headstone on Luna's grave had a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] crescent on top, and their name was inscribed on the gravestone in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Moon/Legends|moon]] crescent on top of Luna's grave is fitting, as "Luna" is [[Wikipedia:Latin|Latin]] for [[Wikipedia:Earth|Earth's]] [[Wikipedia:Moon|moon]].
